title: Draft: Media Type: Have an Export Objects tap, for multipart, HTTP/2, etc.
description:
Move the HTTP export objects tap to media type. Register media type
as a "protocol" that can't be disabled (like ethertype), since export
objects needs that.

Send the data from some other dissectors that use media type, like
ultipart media type and HTTP/2, to the Media Type export objects.

Some other dissectors that use Export Objects could also use this,
which will be added in future commits. There's an IMF export object
already, but there are media types inside it that could be handled.
SIP content bodies should also be sent here.

Fix #11859. Fix #16126. Related to #14995
